about.title: Anderson Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Anderson is a small city, and when someone dies here, the loss is felt well beyond one household. In 2025, public records show 26 injury collisions in Anderson, 40 people hurt, and one traffic death. Fatal crashes and other preventable deaths on Route 273, Interstate 5, Deschutes Road, or North Street may give rise to a civil wrongful death claim in California. The law lets a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children bring that claim first, with certain dependents and heirs eligible in some situations. There is a two-year deadline from the date of death, and it can be much shorter if a public agency is involved. Losses that can be recovered include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm; it is a free service that connects Shasta County families with an independent attorney who handles these claims on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: Our loved one was killed in a crash on Route 273 in Anderson. Is a wrongful death claim different from the criminal case?
items.answer: Yes. A wrongful death claim is a civil action brought by the family, separate from any charges the Shasta County District Attorney may pursue. The civil case focuses on your losses rather than punishment, and it can move forward whether or not a criminal case is filed or how it turns out.

items.question: How long do we have to file in California?
items.answer: Generally two years from the date of death. If a government entity may share fault, such as a road maintained by Caltrans, the county, or the City of Anderson, a formal claim must usually be presented within months, not years. Speaking with an attorney soon helps keep every option open.
